draftkings.name: DraftKings
draftkings.notes: Well-documented eventgroups JSON; US residential proxy usually enough, sometimes an Akamai challenge needs a warmed session.

fanduel.name: FanDuel
fanduel.notes: Akamai-protected; group IDs are state/region dependent and drift. Usually needs warm session cookies (cookie warmer / browser tier).

betmgm.name: BetMGM
betmgm.notes: CDS API family requires a client-generated x-bwin-accessid token; effectively browser-tier (Camoufox) for now — URL is not buildable without token discovery, so the fetcher honestly returns [].

caesars.name: Caesars
caesars.notes: Undocumented, session-bound, changes on app updates; browser tier.

pointsbet.name: PointsBet
pointsbet.notes: Historically a public no-auth JSON feed (regional hosts); Cloudflare may 403 datacenter IPs — Webshare residential usually passes.

betrivers.name: BetRivers
betrivers.notes: Community-documented listview/details JSON; needs US geo, plain Chrome UA usually enough via residential proxy.

barstool.name: Barstool
barstool.notes: Platform largely folded into ESPN BET (2023-24); legacy surface, browser tier required if anything is still live.

wynnbet.name: WynnBET
wynnbet.notes: App shut down 2024; kept for historical parity, effectively dead.

betway_us.name: Betway US
betway_us.notes: Limited US footprint, undocumented; browser tier.

espnbet.name: ESPN BET
espnbet.notes: Penn internal API, undocumented, session-bound; browser tier.
